view.subtitle: Uploads, files agents produced and changes in the project folder
view.added: Files added. To give them to agents, share them in the chat or a task, or allow access under Access.
view.emptyHint: Drag files here, into the chat, onto an agent's terminal or onto a task. PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, CSV, text, JSON, Markdown and images can be read; agents read long files part by part.

preview.confirmDeleteWorkspace: The record is deleted; the file in the project folder is not touched.
preview.confirmDelete: Delete the file and its extracted text? It can no longer be opened from linked messages and tasks.
preview.openBlocked: This type is not opened directly for security reasons; download it
preview.suspiciousBody: File content is always given to agents as “untrusted data”; instructions in it are not followed. Examples:
preview.noOriginal: The original file is not on disk (it may have been deleted after a backup was restored); only the extracted text remains.
preview.imageUnavailable: The image cannot be previewed (the original is missing or larger than 15 MB).

access.intro: Default: no agent can read it. Only whoever the file was sent to (lead, agent, team) can read it. The agent doing a task can also read files attached to that task. Agents can only read files; they cannot change or delete them.
access.shareAll: Let the whole project team read it

task.hint: The agent doing the task can read them · drag and drop

parts.attachTitle: Add files (drag and drop and paste work too) — PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, CSV, text, JSON, Markdown, images
